local.animo: Previa Flashscore: Elversberg may have lost 2-1 to Borussia Dortmund just before the international break, but their tally of 13 Bundesliga points (W4, D1, L4) is still a great return for a team that many tipped to go straight back down. Indeed, since the 1970s, only one side has scored more goals at this stage in their first-ever season in the division (Hoffenheim in 2008/09 with 24), while only Bayern Munich and Leipzig have found the net more often on average in German top-flight home matches this term. Across this Bundesliga campa Bajas según Flashscore: Mickelson N. (Injury), Pinckert L. (Ankle Injury), Seifert L. (Ankle Injury).
